provenance.note: One run per source, aggregated. Each source has its own sealed set, so provenance is per source rather than a single seal.

reproducibility.note: Agreement between repeated responses to the same episode. Undefined without repeats, and never a substitute for accuracy: a system can be consistently wrong.

note: Arm E is the engine answering with the engine's own answer. It measures the harness and the solver, never an advantage over anything — the competitive question needs the other arms and a locked split.
